description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It categorizes costs by a specified stack key ('environment' or 'cost_category'), fills in missing categories with a default label, and sorts services and categories as configured.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a structured dataset for stacked visualization, organizing costs by service and category, with optional sorting and labeling.
